audit_mechanism_limits: This manifest is a point-in-time record of file hashes. It is NOT tamper-proof: an actor with write access can regenerate it after altering any file. Its value is in making silent drift detectable by a reviewer who compares hashes across time, not in preventing modification. Hashes are recorded so a third party can recompute them.
